unit.why: A single narrative: a mitnaged rabbi's student nearly dies, sees a heavenly court where angels honour the Maggid of Kozienice and the Seer of Lublin, revives, and the rabbi becomes their disciple.

stories.start_quote: עוד כ׳ אלי ידי"נ הגה"ח אבד"ק פלונסק
stories.end_quote: ומאז נעשה תלמידם המהר"ם רוטענבורג ז"ל
stories.summary_en: R. Moshe Rottenburg of Wlodawa opposed the Besht's disciples. His brilliant student fell ill and seemed to die. When he revived he told how he was brought before a great heavenly court, where angels made way for the Maggid of Kozienice and the Seer of Lublin, who ordered him back to this world; after this the rabbi became their disciple.
